purpose: Separate semantic freshness from Git provenance drift for frozen Soldier closeout artifacts while preserving fail-closed behavior for real semantic change and unresolved legacy drift.

owned: semantic digest envelope and comparison rules
legacy gitBlobSha compatibility during incremental migration
projection identities for Soldier Stage 6-6 and shared Hero-Soldier relation consumers
notOwned: Hero or Soldier canonical identity research

canonicalization.arrayOrder: preserved unless the named projection explicitly defines semantic sorting before canonicalization

helperCompatibility.rule: The helper receives an explicit semantic payload. It must not perform generic recursive metadata stripping.

legacy.meaning: Exact repository-byte provenance only. It proves freshness when current and recorded blob SHAs still match.

v2.meaning: gitBlobSha remains audit provenance; semanticDigest is the semantic freshness authority for the registered projection.

SEMANTIC_FRESH.rule: Recorded and current semantic digests match under the same contract, algorithm and projection; provenance may match or be unavailable.

PROVENANCE_ONLY_CHANGED.rule: Recorded and current semantic digests match, but current gitBlobSha differs from recorded gitBlobSha.

SEMANTIC_STALE.rule: A valid recorded V2 semantic digest and a valid current digest under the same projection differ.

SEMANTIC_UNKNOWN.rule: Semantic equality cannot be proven because digest data is missing/invalid, projection identity is incompatible, or legacy bytes changed without a V2 semantic digest.

rules.condition: legacy descriptor has no semanticDigest and current gitBlobSha equals recorded gitBlobSha
rules.reason: Byte identity is stronger than semantic equality and permits incremental migration without bulk resealing.

rules.condition: legacy descriptor has no semanticDigest and current gitBlobSha differs from recorded gitBlobSha
rules.reason: Without a registered semantic digest, changed bytes cannot be safely interpreted as metadata-only drift.

rules.condition: legacy descriptor has no semanticDigest and either recorded or current gitBlobSha is unavailable
rules.reason: Neither exact-byte nor semantic equality can be proven.

v2ComparisonRules: Contract, algorithm and projection identity must match before digest bytes are comparable.
Projection mismatch is SEMANTIC_UNKNOWN, never semantic equality.
Current semantic digest must be recomputed from the current artifact using the registered projection; consumers must not trust an embedded digest alone.
Valid semantic match plus raw SHA drift is PROVENANCE_ONLY_CHANGED and remains visible in audit/review output without blocking semantic admission.
Semantic mismatch is blocking even when raw SHA matches or is unavailable.
Unknown or malformed V2 digest data is fail-closed SEMANTIC_UNKNOWN.

projectionPolicy.unknownFields: not silently included; projection code explicitly maps semantic fields and bumps projection id when semantic shape changes
projectionPolicy.ordering: Each projection declares whether array order is semantic or normalized before digesting.

soldier-stage6-6-expansion-basis/semanti.purpose: Semantic identity of the Stage 6-6 expansion-basis manifest without audit timestamps, provenance snapshots or prose-only documentation.

soldier-stage6-6-expansion-validation/se.purpose: Semantic identity of Stage 6-6 validation results while ignoring audit snapshots and prose wording.

payload.reviews: map each review to {code, classification, count?}; sort by code then classification

hero-soldier-membership/v1.payload: relation.edges -> {heroId, soldierId}, sorted by heroId then soldierId
validation: heroId and soldierId must be integers
relation provenance and raw gitBlobSha are excluded

hero-soldier-relation/semantic-v1.purpose: Canonical pair identity plus semantic relation provenance.
hero-soldier-relation/semantic-v1.ordering: Sort edges by heroId then soldierId; normalize each provenance object to the explicit field shape and sort provenance entries by canonical JSON.

soldier-stage4-6-relation-consumer.migrationRule: Do not weaken existing semantic/index parity checks; replace raw-SHA-only freshness decisions only when the required projection digest is available.

soldier-stage6-5-reciprocal-links.reason: Stage 6-5 owns reciprocal page membership parity, not provenance-source interpretation.

v2Target: use legacy exact-SHA compatibility for unmigrated refs
report but do not block PROVENANCE_ONLY_CHANGED

literalPinPolicy.rule: P1 does not reinterpret these literal SHA-256 gates as provenance-only. They remain blocking byte-authority pins until a separate evidence-backed contract revision explicitly migrates them.

migrationOrder: P3: add Stage 6-6 manifest/validation semantic digests using the two Stage 6-6 projections; retain existing gitBlobSha fields.
P4: update Stage 6-7 to evaluate V2 refs first and legacy exact-SHA refs second using this contract.
Later: migrate Stage 6-5 and Stage 4-6 relation consumers to registered relation projections only after dedicated regression coverage.
Do not bulk-migrate Stage 5/6 producers solely to satisfy P3/P4.
forbidden: Treat raw gitBlobSha drift alone as semantic corruption when a valid matching V2 digest proves semantic equality.
Treat a legacy raw-SHA mismatch as provenance-only without a semantic digest.
Trust an embedded semanticDigest without recomputing the current projection.
Use a generic recursive field blacklist to build production semantic payloads.
Compare digests across different projection IDs.
Silently migrate literal relation pin gates.
Change workflow transport, branch protection or pr-guard exit policy in P1.
completion: P1 is complete when the V2 digest envelope, freshness classifications, legacy fallback, Stage 6-6 pilot projections, relation projections, consumer mapping and literal-pin boundary are frozen without modifying production frozen artifacts or workflow transport.
